What is Akh Va'quot Shrine?

The , designated by the Trial name Windmills, is an in this story. The Akh Va'quot Shrine is located in , southwest of the . As Link enters the , he is greeted by the Shrine's , . Akh Va'quot Shrine features a central chamber containing six fans and 14 windmills.

In order to complete the Trial, Link must strike the accompanying the fans to rotate them in an order that hits all windmills at once. Once this is done, a portcullis leading to Akh Va'quot will rise allowing Link to speak to him.

He will give Link a for completing the Trial, and will wish Link well before fading away. A room behind the elevator features a long pool of water and a floating platform holding a Switch and a fan that will release a portcullis protecting a containing an .

Two niches along the wall of the pool contain two Treasure Chests, containing a and a respectively.
